panels.description: At night inside and immediately outside GODARAZ, indistinct local testers stand behind the lanes. Pinty connects a crude tractor jumper to the alley’s internal wiring while a separate temporary service meter and generator box remains at the threshold. Leave upper-right for lettering.

The power cuts mid-frame. Tractor light enters the dark alley. The Dude holds a finished buffalo-milk White Russian in a distinct mixed drink glass just after tasting it. Keep upper-left counter space clear.
A small video screen shows Walter’s intense face and laminated rulebook; the dark alley surrounds it. Keep the screen’s top edge clear.

At the GODARAZ threshold beneath the oversized z, two apologetic goons speak with the worried power contractor beside the distinct temporary service meter and generator box. Keep the warehouse wall clear for dialogue.

items.speaker: WALTER
items.text: A power cut is not a philosophy. It is a ruling.
